definition: זֹ֫הַר noun [masculine] shining, brightness (Arabic , Late Hebrew זְהוֺר , compare Aramaic זִיהֲרָא ); — absolute Ezek 8:2 ׳ כְּמַרְאֵה ז like an appearance of shining (explained, v b, as resembling amber, חַשְׁמַל compare Ezek 1:27 ); also construct Dan 12:3 see foregoing.

זֹ֫הַר noun [masculine] shining, brightness (Arabic , Late Hebrew זְהוֺר, compare Aramaic זִיהֲרָא); — absolute Ezek 8:2 ׳כְּמַרְאֵה ז like an appearance of shining (explained, vb, as resembling amber, חַשְׁמַל compare Ezek 1:27); also construct Dan 12:3 see foregoing.
